payload.note: A decree is an authoritative pronouncement with the force of law, issued by a governing authority. The removal test: remove the concept of law and a decree loses its defining attribute of legal force — it becomes merely an announcement. Direction: decree (specific type) to law (general category).

Oversight is systematic monitoring and review to ensure compliance and correctness. The removal test: remove monitoring and oversight cannot exist — it is monitoring with institutional scope and authority. Without the mechanism of monitoring (observation, tracking, checking), oversight has no operational content. Direction: oversight (systematic monitoring) to monitoring (constitutive mechanism).

A grouped bar chart organizes bars into categories with subgroups within each category. The removal test: remove bar chart and the visual encoding of categorical values as rectangular bars vanishes — grouped bar chart is a specific variant of bar chart. Direction: grouped bar chart (specific variant) to bar chart (general form).

A rug plot displays individual data points as marks along a single axis, showing the distribution of one variable. The removal test: remove scatter plot (the concept of plotting individual points on axes) and a rug plot has no operational mechanism — it is a 1D scatter plot variant. Direction: rug plot (1D scatter) to scatter plot (general point-plotting concept).

payload.body: A decree is a human-made authoritative pronouncement issued by a governing authority or sovereign that has the force of law. Parameters: (1) the issuing authority (sovereign, executive, administrative body), (2) the subject matter of the directive, (3) the scope of application (individual, group, or general). Persistence mechanism: recorded in legal documents and gazettes, enforced through institutional compliance. Display trailer: decree is a specific form of law that derives its authority from the position of the issuer rather than legislative process.

payload.reasoning: Note pins 'oversight is monitoring with institutional scope and authority' — an IS-A identity, which Law 8c says files as INSTANCE_OF, never DEPENDS_ON. And against the target's own accepted definition, oversight operates 'through defined mechanisms of review, audit, reporting, or intervention' — monitoring is one enumerated mechanism, not the constitutive one; remove monitoring and oversight still operates via audit/review/reporting. The removal test the note gives ('oversight cannot exist') is the 2b 'stops being sayable' test, which is true of every entry and files nothing.

Note's own direction line pins the sense: 'rug plot (1D scatter) to scatter plot (general point-plotting concept)' and 'it is a 1D scatter plot variant' — an IS-A identity. Law 8c: identity is not dependency. If the filer believes the relationship holds, the edge to file is INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind (scatter plot), not DEPENDS_ON. A rug mark (ticks along one axis) is a freestanding mark; removing the scatter-plot concept does not stop a rug plot from being drawn — 'no operational mechanism' is the 2b sayable-test in costume.

Note pins the sense 'it is a property OF a waveform' — a property relation to its subject is not an operational dependency (Law 8c; property-not-constituent pattern). And the removal test 'remove waveform and phase has nothing to describe' is the Law 2b sayable-test: against waveform's own accepted definition, a waveform is a MAPPING of a signal's amplitude onto a temporal axis — a representation, not the substance. Phase is a state variable of the periodic signal itself (its def: 'determines waveform alignment and interference'); remove the mapping and the signal still has phase. At most this is DERIVED_FROM (the parameter was named and measured via waveform practice), never DEPENDS_ON.

Against the target's own accepted definition, pre-ringing is 'a human-made signal processing artifact… caused by linear-phase filter design' — its mechanism IS 'the symmetric impulse response of linear-phase filters.' The removal test holds operationally: remove linear-phase filtering and the artifact cannot occur (post-ringing from asymmetric filters is a different entry). This is not an identity (it is not a kind of filter) and not chronology — it is an artifact on its producing mechanism, the same constitutive shape as decimation on anti-aliasing. DEPENDS_ON is the correct type for the pinned sense.

Against spectral-whitening's own accepted definition, the technique operates 'by dividing the signal's spectrum by its estimated envelope or by applying a whitening filter derived from the power spectral density' — with parameters 'estimation window length for spectral envelope, smoothing method for envelope estimation.' Obtaining the spectral shape IS spectral analysis (its accepted def: decomposing a signal into frequency components and examining energy distribution). Remove that practice and whitening has no envelope to invert and no filter to derive — the operation stops, not just the description. Present-tense necessity (Law 8a), not chronology, not identity: whitening is not a kind of analysis, it is a process whose mechanism is an analysis result. DEPENDS_ON is the right type for the pinned sense.

The operative object of whitening is a NON-FLAT magnitude spectrum: its accepted def says it flattens 'by dividing the signal's spectrum by its estimated envelope.' Spectral-coloration (its own def: 'deviation of a signal's magnitude spectrum from flatness') is the NAME of that non-flatness, not a constitutive mechanism. Remove the concept of coloration and the spectrum is still non-flat and the flattening still operates — what stops is the description, not the operation (Law 2b). 'No operational target' fails: the target is the non-flat spectrum itself. A correction relation (whitening removes coloration) is not DEPENDS_ON.

Removal test fails. The accepted cepstral-analysis def carves the input as 'a magnitude spectrum', and its sibling cepstrum def pins the spectrum as computed 'via FFT'. The note concedes 'typically derived from STFT magnitude' — 'typically' is not constitutive. Remove STFT and the technique still operates with a plain DFT/FFT (classical homomorphic filtering predates and does not require windowing). The real substrate is the Fourier transform / magnitude spectrum; STFT is one route to a time-localized spectrum, not the dependency the arrow claims.
